title: Default workflow adoption with mandatory acceleration controls and duplicated-mechanics retirement
effect_of_pass: Authorize implementation of the exact closed profile, all five mandatory controls and non-destructive retirement while preserving governing-plan exceptions and permanent denials.
effect_of_defer: Preserve all current programme-specific mechanics and keep the proposal inactive.
effect_of_block: Mark DA-G6 blocked and preserve completed Development Acceleration components as opt-in services only.
effect_of_quarantine: Quarantine the adoption proposal without altering completed packet records or active DA-G4B authority.
effect_of_supersede: Require a replacement adoption plan and new operator gate before default activation or retirement.
